parsed.why: Restrictive state: school/state-building facility bans, hostile ID and adult healthcare rules, no state gender-identity discrimination or hate-crime coverage. National border/custody exposure remains; rates below parent.

Strong visitor-facing protections: public-accommodation and hate-crime law, healthcare shield, Most Protective tier. Unenforced sodomy statutes are secondary; national border/custody still caps score.
No current statewide bathroom ban and hate-crime law covers gender identity, but hostile ID/care rules and no statewide accommodation protections. Slightly above parent, not protective tier.

Most Protective tier: comprehensive anti-discrimination, gender-neutral facilities, hate-crime law, shield statute, strong local recourse. Highest of the five despite hostile national border/custody regime.

Worst state layer: explicit government-building/airport restroom ban with criminal trespass, ID and care restrictions, no gender-identity protections, travel advisory. Lowest, though not near-certain imprisonment.
